5a993aa5a4781167.description: Job description Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. The team works closely with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to maintain accurate accounts and support timely collections. This role is based in Riyadh with a flexible work arrangement. As a Credit & Collections Clerk III, you will manage a portfolio of customer accounts, follow up on overdue payments, reconcile balances, and resolve invoice discrepancies. Working with healthcare customers, Sales, Customer Care, and Finance, you will help remove payment barriers and maintain accurate account records. Your work will directly contribute to timely collections, reduced overdue receivables, and stronger customer relationships. Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies involving invoices, payments, and credit notes. Coordinate with Sales, Customer Care, and Finance to resolve disputes and remove payment barriers. Monitor payment commitments and escalate overdue accounts or potential credit risks in line with company procedures. Maintain accurate records of collection activities, customer communications, and account status. Prepare accounts receivable updates highlighting overdue balances, collection progress, and required follow-up actions. 5a2c8128097815a8.description: About Aloula Aviation Aloula Aviation, located in Dammam, Eastern Region, is seeking a Sr Aircraft Maintenance Planner to join its team. This full-time role involves essential planning functions for aircraft maintenance operations, supporting the Saudi Aramco fleet. Role Overview The Sr Aircraft Maintenance Planner performs core production planning for line and hangar maintenance, including scheduled maintenance and modification incorporation. The role involves SAP entry for routine and non-routine work cards, preparing statistical information, and other critical maintenance planning data to support work scope development and maintenance forecasts. Familiarity with the Fleet Planner function is required. Key Responsibilities Support other planners and process routine and non-routine maintenance forms. Perform SAP entry for routine and non-routine work cards. Ensure daily status reports are reviewed and accurately reflect aircraft availability. Return dismantled parts to material personnel, including historical cards if applicable, for external repair. Assist Planner II in updating maintenance programs as revisions are received. Maintain a standard maintenance record filing system, ensuring information accessibility for maintenance personnel. Ensure refreshment orders are created following equipment dismantlement. Provide production planning support by creating defect notifications and unplanned orders in SAP, duplicating information from non-routine write-ups. Verify data of involved parts in the system (Equipment) and define correct equipment numbers based on serial numbers. Maintain man-hours according to non-routine tasks, update aircraft time counters for proper notification closure (TECO), and perform planner board corrections. Update notifications with corrective actions as reflected in non-routine discrepancies. Ensure system data matches hard copy records. Obtain physical verification of dismantled parts, serial numbers, part numbers, and perform equipment movements. Provide data to the Senior Planner for the development of maintenance schedules and budget reports. Collaborate with Planner II to identify long-term requirements and advise on work accomplishment timelines. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 6 years of experience in aircraft maintenance office and administrative duties. Minimum of 1 year of experience in the specialized field of aircraft maintenance planning. Working knowledge of computer applications relevant to maintenance and inspection tracking is preferable. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern Region, supporting the planning functions for the Saudi Aramco fleet under the direction of a Senior Planner.

5ac3c02e69902d28.description: About the Role: Senior Manager - Digital Community Services Khatib & Alami is seeking a Senior Manager - Digital Community Services to lead and manage the integrated Community Services function in Jeddah, Western Province. This full-time role focuses on delivering safe, accessible, high-quality, and digitally enabled services that enhance the experience of residents, visitors, businesses, and community partners. The Senior Manager will translate community needs and organizational objectives into effective service strategies, operating models, service standards, and technology-driven solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the community services strategy, ensuring alignment with the master plan, smart-city vision, customer experience priorities, and organizational objectives. Define, develop, and oversee end-to-end community services, including community engagement, resident support, public-realm activation, permits and service requests, mobility touchpoints, safety communications, and digital service channels. Lead the implementation and continuous enhancement of an integrated community services ecosystem, including mobile applications, web portals, CRM and case management systems, self-service solutions, digital notifications, and knowledge management platforms. Integrate community-facing services with relevant smart-city platforms and data sources, such as mobility, security, access control, facilities management, events, and operational dashboards, to enable seamless service delivery and informed decision-making. Establish and maintain service standards, standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation mechanisms, service-level agreements (SLAs), governance frameworks, and vendor-management controls. Develop effective resident and stakeholder engagement mechanisms, including surveys, feedback channels, community forums, and service performance analytics, translating insights into actionable initiatives. Collaborate with planning, ICT, security, facilities management, operations, procurement, and communications to ensure coordinated service delivery. Identify, evaluate, and pilot emerging technologies and innovative service solutions, including AI-enabled service assistants, process automation, predictive analytics, and connected mobility. Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service delivery metrics, customer satisfaction measures, and operational dashboards to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and organizational policies, maintaining controls for information security, data privacy, business continuity, and emergency communications. Lead, develop, and empower the Community Services team, establishing clear accountabilities, performance objectives, and development plans. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience in community services, digital service delivery, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in leading and managing integrated service functions. Proven ability to translate community needs and organizational objectives into strategic plans and operational models. Skills and Competencies Strong leadership and team development capabilities. Proficiency in developing and implementing digital community platforms and smart-city integrations. Excellent strategic planning, operational governance, and performance management skills. Ability to foster cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement. Strong understanding of risk management, compliance, and data integrity principles. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Western Province, requiring leadership within a dynamic and collaborative environment focused on community enhancement and digital innovation. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

5a18cf0909abf579.description: Job description Job Description: Tailoring / Pattern Maker & Industrial Tailor Job Title: Pattern Maker & Industrial Tailor Department: Production and Operations Department Job Objective: Prepare and detail patterns accurately, cut fabrics efficiently to minimize waste, and sew and assemble pieces with industrial finishing quality that meets the operator's standards.Key Responsibilities * Drawing and Modifying Patterns: Drawing and modifying basic patterns (flat or digital) for various models (dresses, casual wear, women's clothing), and matching measurements and measurement tables accurately. * Fabric Cutting and Marker Making: Spreading fabric and determining the direction of the fabric, arranging pattern pieces with maximum efficiency to minimize waste (Fabric Wastage), and cutting pieces accurately using manual and electric cutting scissors. * Industrial Sewing and Operations: Sewing and assembling pieces using industrial sewing machines (Single Needle Lockstitch, Overlock/Serger 4 & 5 threads, and Coverstitch/Flatlock machines if available). * Finishing: Executing invisible zippers, trims, cuffs, pintucks, and finishing seams with high quality and complete cleanliness of threads from inside and outside. * Sample Inspection and Adjusting Prototypes: Sewing initial samples, and making necessary adjustments to measurements or cuts after trial measurements. * Maintenance and Operation of Equipment: Adjusting thread tension standards, changing needles according to fabric type and thickness, and regular cleaning and lubrication of machines. Skills Technical and Hard Skills Pattern Making & Grading: Flat Pattern Drafting accurately according to measurement tables. Grading adjustments for pieces to fit multiple sizes (S, M, L, XL). Ease adjustments and control over cutting lines and proportions. Fitting adjustments based on fitting samples and correcting fitting issues. Industrial Cutting Techniques: Marker Making to maximize fabric utilization and minimize waste. Grainline determination and matching fabric directions and patterns. Proficiency in manual and industrial cutting machines. Creating notches and markings for accurate assembly. Industrial Machine Operation: Single Needle Lockstitch machine operation with precision. Overlock/Serger operation for seam finishing. Coverstitch/Flatlock for hemming and finishing. Initial mechanical adjustments for tension and needle selection. Fabric Knowledge: Handling delicate and flowing fabrics without distortion. Working with stretch fabrics and ensuring seam elasticity. Understanding properties of stable and structured fabrics. Professional Finishing Techniques: Expertise in installing zippers and finishing garments. Executing various pocket styles and cuffs. Topstitching and pintucks for decorative finishes. Under-pressing for final shape accuracy. Soft Skills: Attention to detail and precision in sewing. Time management and performance speed. Flexibility and problem-solving skills. Organizational skills and workspace cleanliness.

The specialist will contribute to building enterprise capabilities that leverage trusted data, machine learning, automation, and agentic AI concepts to enhance productivity, operational performance, and business decision-making. Design and deliver predictive, prescriptive, diagnostic, and exploratory analytics solutions that support decision-making across business and operational domains. Develop machine learning models, statistical analyses, simulations, optimization approaches, and advanced analytics products using enterprise data assets. Support the development of agentic AI use cases by defining data, model, workflow, evaluation, and decision-support requirements. Collaborate with AI engineers, platform teams, data engineers, and business stakeholders to embed analytics and machine learning into autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows. Communicate insights, risks, limitations, and recommended actions clearly to technical, operational, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into clear data science problem statements and analytical approaches. Experience in designing and delivering predictive, prescriptive, diagnostic, and exploratory analytics solutions. Proficiency in developing machine learning models, statistical analyses, simulations, and optimization approaches. Experience with data science governance practices, including model validation, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management. Agentic AI use cases are supported by robust models, evaluation methods, controls, and human oversight. Analytics and AI products are reusable, well-documented, governed, monitored, and compliant with responsible AI expectations. Stakeholders receive clear insights, recommendations, and decision support that enhance productivity and performance.

5adc367f5f6816bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحليل عناصر المشاريع، ووضع الخطط الزمنية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وإدارة التدفقات النقدية، وتحليل المخاطر لضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل عناصر وفعاليات المشروع، وتحديد ارتباطاتها وترتيبها، ودراسة قيمة المشروع وحجمه، وإعداد برنامج زمني مفصل وترتيب الإجراءات اللازمة. تحديد الموارد المادية والبشرية المطلوبة لتنفيذ المشروع، ومتابعة توفيرها في التوقيتات المناسبة. إعداد جدول تدفق نقدي يتناسب مع تسلسل تنفيذ فعاليات المشروع. مراجعة التنفيذ والتقدم الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالبرنامج المخطط له، وإعداد البرامج المعدلة والمنقحة، وتطوير أساليب وتقنيات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة المشاريع، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل عناصر المشروع وتحديد المتطلبات بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للموظفين تطوير مهاراتهم في مجال إدارة المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة معين للموارد البشرية.

5adc3d4dd48b96b8.description: About the Role SHEIN is seeking a Business Development professional to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on expanding the company's merchant network and optimizing business cooperation within the non-beauty sector in the region. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Identify and engage non-beauty brand owners and distributors in Saudi Arabia to establish and maintain long-term cooperative relationships. Expand the regional cooperative merchant database through proactive outreach and relationship building. Manage end-to-end business cooperation, including requirement communication, proposal development, negotiation, and contract signing. Coordinate with internal operation teams to ensure the successful implementation of cooperation terms and achievement of set goals. Undertake performance indicators such as the number of cooperative merchants and Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV). Track performance data, analyze bottlenecks, and drive strategy optimization to meet targets. Monitor local non-beauty consumption trends, competitor strategies, and policy changes. Produce analytical reports to support the company’s strategic adjustments based on market insights. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, merchant acquisition, or a related field, preferably within the e-commerce or retail sector in Saudi Arabia. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic team focused on market expansion and strategic partnerships. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be provided to qualified candidates.

5ae5411777c96c31.description: About Tahaluf Tahaluf focuses on creating events, building communities, and delivering digital experiences. The company aims to redefine the events industry, aligning with the Vision 2030 initiatives. Tahaluf is expanding its portfolio beyond established events like LEAP and Black Hat Middle East to launch new large-scale business-to-business events across various sectors including technology, real estate, food, pop culture, intermobility, and beauty within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Sales Manager Cityscape will be responsible for overseeing assigned territories and contributing to the achievement of sales revenue targets. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of experience. The role involves working with local and international clients, particularly within the real estate sector, to drive sales for Cityscape events. Key Responsibilities Achieve sales revenue targets, manage campaigns, and oversee floor plans within established timelines. Meet Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) including phone time, face-to-face meetings, and CRM system usage. Ensure exhibitor satisfaction through regular follow-ups, onsite rebookings, and retention strategies. Provide timely and accurate reporting of sales results, pipeline, and activities. Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and clients, especially in the real estate sector. Support business development efforts and identify new sales opportunities, including innovative hunting techniques. Execute sales strategies for both established events and new launches. Assist with project timelines and deliverables for event launches. Collaborate with marketing, operations, and content teams to ensure seamless event execution. Track the sales pipeline and work towards achieving targets, including organic sales growth. Represent Tahaluf at trade shows and industry events. Support team members in their sales activities and contribute to team restructuring efforts. Measures of Success Achievement of revenue targets and pipeline pacing. Number of proposals submitted per week and pipeline closure rates. Effectiveness in research and lead generation. Campaign planning and management results. Business development outcomes, including new client acquisition and retention. Exhibitor satisfaction levels and onsite rebooking rates. Benefits and Relocation Tahaluf offers a comprehensive benefits package including BUPA Medical Insurance for the employee and family, 25 days of annual leave, remote working options on Sundays, and one month of remote work annually. Wellbeing benefits are also provided. For expatriates, family visa costs (up to three children) and an individual annual flight allowance are included. An International Relocation Package is available, covering a paid flight to Riyadh for the employee and family (up to three children), 60 days of accommodation or a serviced apartment upon arrival (or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000), and up to SAR 2,500 reimbursement for shipping goods or excess baggage costs. This package also includes an individual paid flight home and an end-of-service gratuity payment upon leaving the company. A Local Relocation Package is also available, offering a paid flight to Riyadh for the individual and family (up to three children), 30 days of accommodation or a serviced apartment (or a one-off payment of SAR 5,000), and up to SAR 2,500 reimbursement for shipping goods or excess baggage costs, if eligible.

5a3b1f3922232fc2.description: نبحث عن محضر قهوة (باريستا) شغوف ومبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا. المسؤوليات الرئيسية: - تحضير وتقديم مشروبات القهوة المتخصصة - تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وسريعة - المساهمة في تطوير قائمة المشروبات وتقديم أفكار جديدة. - تقديم المساعدة والعمل مع الفريق *الراتب يحدد بحسب سنوات الخبرة والمهارة*

5a46c26e7d03719c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الودق لتقديم الوجبات عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بكفاءة، وضمان دقة التسويات المالية، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عدّ المبالغ المالية وتسجيلها في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع ضمان توافر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو الطرق الأخرى المعتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أية اختلافات أو تسويتها. التعامل بوجه رحب مع العملاء وتلبية رغباتهم بالإضافة أو الحذف على قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الانتباه للتفاصيل والتفاعل المباشر مع العملاء. عن شركة الودق لتقديم الوجبات تلتزم شركة الودق لتقديم الوجبات بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة لعملائها، وتسعى لضم الكفاءات التي تساهم في تحقيق أهدافها التشغيلية وخدمة العملاء. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يمتلكون المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة.

5a6f96cdefc842e6.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Site Manager Electrical (Substation) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the electrical construction execution for substation projects, ensuring adherence to SEC standards and project requirements. The Site Manager will be responsible for site coordination, subcontractor management, quality, safety, and timely project completion. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage electrical construction activities for 380kV substation/BSP projects. Plan and monitor site execution, including manpower, materials, equipment, and daily progress. Coordinate with SEC, consultants, subcontractors, and project teams to ensure smooth execution. Ensure all works comply with SEC standards, approved drawings, specifications, and project procedures. Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, cable works, equipment erection, and related electrical activities. Monitor project schedules, identify potential delays, and implement corrective actions to achieve project milestones. Review drawings, method statements, ITPs, and other technical documents prior to execution. Manage subcontractors to ensure productivity, quality, safety, and timely completion of their scope. Coordinate with Civil, Protection & Control, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, and Procurement teams. Conduct site inspections and ensure proper resolution of technical and construction issues. Support testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, and SEC inspection/approval activities. Prepare progress reports and provide regular updates to the Project Manager and senior management. Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and promote a zero-incident project execution environment. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of hands-on experience with SEC projects and SEC construction standards. Strong knowledge of GIS installation, power transformers, switchgear, protection systems, cable works, and commissioning activities. Excellent leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills. SEC-Specific Requirements Experience working on SEC-approved 380kV Substation Projects is preferred. Familiarity with SEC General Specifications (SGS), SEC Safety Regulations, and SEC project execution procedures. Ability to coordinate directly with SEC Project Management and Construction Supervision teams. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

5a3e5f4b91beb7ba.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Senior Structural Engineer to oversee the erection and installation of steel structures for Overground metro stations in Riyadh. This full-time role involves ensuring structural integrity, quality, and compliance with international standards throughout the construction phase of platforms, concourses, foot overbridges, and roofing systems. Key Responsibilities Supervise the erection and installation of steel structures for Overground metro stations, including platforms, concourses, foot overbridges, and roofing systems. Ensure all structural works adhere to approved drawings, specifications, and relevant codes (IS, IRC, Eurocode, etc.). Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and internal teams to resolve technical issues on-site. Monitor construction progress, quality control, and adherence to safety protocols. Conduct regular site inspections and prepare detailed reports on structural works, including non-conformities and corrective actions. Review and verify shop drawings, method statements, and material submittals related to steel structures. Liaise with design teams to address site-related design modifications or clarifications. Ensure proper documentation of inspections, approvals, and quality records. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in structural engineering, with a focus on steel structures. Demonstrated ability to supervise construction activities and ensure compliance with technical specifications and safety standards. Strong understanding of international structural codes and standards (IS, IRC, Eurocode, etc.). Excellent communication and coordination skills for effective collaboration with various stakeholders. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and managing project documentation. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, where the successful candidate will be actively involved in on-site supervision of metro station construction projects. About AtkinsRéalis AtkinsRéalis is a global engineering services and nuclear organization. The company connects people, data, and technology to transform infrastructure and energy systems. Working with industry partners, clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers, AtkinsRéalis is committed to engineering a better future for the planet and its people. Rewards and Benefits AtkinsRéalis offers a range of rewards and benefits designed to support employees at every stage of their life and career.

5aad7543a4b84d82.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركه المتقدمه للمقاولات العامه والصيانه عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في المجال المحاسبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات المحاسبية والامتثال للإجراءات المعتمدة. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. مهارات في إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق الشركه المتقدمه للمقاولات العامه والصيانه في مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزامًا بالمهام المالية اليومية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.

5ae08d493d8ca0f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حمود عبدالله الصقعبي للمقاولات عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في سكاكا، الجوف. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة عمليات تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة. ضمان توفير الموارد في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة للمشاريع والبرامج. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع الأخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد. تحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها بفعالية. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة الجودة المعتمدة. إدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة للمشروع. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وعملية إغلاقه. تقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والتقارير. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء بشكل دوري. رفع التقارير المتعلقة لمختلف الأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. مهارات في متابعة تطوير خطط التنفيذ ومراقبة سير العمل. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الموازنات والإجراءات التعاقدية للمشاريع. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في سكاكا، الجوف. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في إدارة المشاريع لضمان تحقيق الأهداف بكفاءة وفعالية. ملخص الدور يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع مسؤولية الإشراف الشامل على دورة حياة المشاريع، من التخطيط وتقدير الموارد إلى التنفيذ والمتابعة والإغلاق، مع التركيز على تحقيق الأهداف ضمن الإطار الزمني والميزانية المحددة.

5a140d8779adf0d3.description: About Air Products Air Products is a company focused on innovation, driven by its people and collective experience. The company develops solutions that support various sectors, including aerospace, healthcare, and the construction of large-scale production facilities. The Role of EH&S Supervisor Air Products is seeking an experienced EH&S Supervisor to manage safety and environmental concerns for a 380kV Substation, 380kV underground cable, and 380kV OHTL Project in Tabuk, specifically in Duba and Tabuk. This full-time role requires a candidate with over 10 years of experience in EH&S, particularly in managing substation and OHTL transmission lines, along with strong leadership skills to independently manage the project site and handle emergencies. Key Responsibilities Support the full implementation of the project EH&S Plan. Promote a ‘Total Safety Culture’ and support related leadership activities. Act as a coach for EH&S team members and contractors. Support contractors’ HAZID processes and the Project Emergency Response Plan. Ensure EH&S risks are assessed and mitigation measures are in place. Assist the project team in identifying safety concerns. Coordinate inspections and audits within the accountable area. Ensure safety equipment is regularly inspected, operational, and color-coded. Support the implementation of the Permit to Work process and monitor adherence to LOTO procedures. Ensure all permits are adequately completed and implemented on site. Review and monitor contractors’ safety programs and work practices. Provide EH&S information and expertise to the site team to ensure compliance with Air Products standards and local laws. Coordinate safety training for contractor organizations. Participate in and lead safety promotion events, campaigns, and programs. Provide leadership for prompt prioritization and coordination of unforeseen site issues, escalating to the Air Products EH&S Lead or Manager as needed. Review JSAs developed by contractors to ensure risk mitigation. Attend contractor TBTs and Pre-Task Safety Talks, providing input as applicable. Perform regular safety dialogues and formal PTW/JSA reviews. Provide input for accurate completion of EH&S reports. Ensure all incidents are reported immediately to the Area Construction Manager and EH&S Area Lead. Act as a member of the Site Emergency Response Team as required. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental, health and safety, or a relevant field. NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent is mandatory. Minimum of ten (10) years of experience handling EH&S issues in substation and OHTL transmission line projects. Deep understanding of codes, standards, and regulations concerning environmental protection, occupational health, and safety, particularly in power transmission and distribution projects. Proficiency in incident investigations. Excellent supervisory, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work long hours and travel to remote areas to oversee project sites. Experience in Saudi Arabia is an advantage. A KSA/International Driving license is required. Fluent spoken and written English. Physically fit and able to spend a large proportion of the day on site. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Tabuk, covering project sites in Duba and Tabuk. The role involves significant time on-site and requires flexibility for extended working hours and travel to remote locations. Application Information Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

5a494f6275aaed14.description: About AtkinsRéalis AtkinsRéalis is a global engineering services and nuclear organization. The company connects people, data, and technology to transform infrastructure and energy systems. Working with industry partners, clients, and a global team of consultants, designers, engineers, and project managers, AtkinsRéalis is committed to engineering a better future for the planet and its people. The Role of Quality Engineer AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Quality Engineer (Site Operations) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience. The Quality Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that construction projects adhere to all quality control and quality assurance procedures on-site. The position involves close collaboration with the site management team, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure compliance with specifications, standards, and regulations. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor quality control processes for construction activities on-site, ensuring work is performed in accordance with approved plans, drawings, and specifications. Perform site inspections and coordinate testing of materials, equipment, and processes to ensure compliance with quality standards. Accurately record and report results. Identify and document any deviations or non-conformance issues. Collaborate with site teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure corrective and preventive actions are taken. Maintain clear, accurate records of inspections, tests, reports, and non-conformance issues. Prepare and submit regular quality control reports to project managers and senior management. Liaise with contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure quality standards are met during construction and to resolve any quality-related concerns. Support internal and external audits to ensure compliance with project specifications, local regulations, and international standards (*, ISO 9001). Assist in identifying areas for improvement in quality processes and contribute to initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall quality of project delivery. Ensure that all quality-related concerns from clients and stakeholders are addressed promptly and professionally. Support client inspections and reviews as required.
